# scc_file_plan_property_citation (Resource)

Manages the FilePlanPropertyCitation object via New-FilePlanPropertyCitation / Get-FilePlanPropertyCitation / Set-FilePlanPropertyCitation / Remove-FilePlanPropertyCitation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Optional

- `citation_jurisdiction` (String) Maps to the -CitationJurisdiction parameter.
- `citation_url` (String) Maps to the -CitationUrl parameter.
- `display_name` (String) Maps to the -DisplayName parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
